manual_103.topic: 4 GTA 6 settings to change: subtitles (Mission Only by default, set to all dialogue in the UI tab), Camera Bob (10 → 3-5), Motion Blur under Display (0-1), Camera Shake off in the Camera tab

4 GTA 6 settings to change first: subtitles only show in missions, so set them to all dialogue in the UI tab; drop Camera Bob from 10 to 3-5; slide Motion Blur (Display) to 0 or 1; and turn Camera Shake off in the Camera tab so chases are far easier to follow.

manual_108.topic: GTA 6 has no mission replay (unlike GTA 5) and you can't save mid-mission; there are 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, so save to a fresh slot before every chapter finale (and at the start and end of each chapter)
manual_108.title: GTA 6 has NO mission replay ⚠️ (save before it's too late) | GTA 6 ما فيها إعادة للمهمات ⚠️ #shorts
manual_108.title_en: GTA 6 has NO mission replay ⚠️ (save before it's too late)
manual_108.caption:
GTA 6 has NO mission replay ⚠️ (save before it's too late) | GTA 6 ما فيها إعادة للمهمات ⚠️

GTA 6 has no mission replay: unlike GTA 5, once a story mission is done you can't play it again, and you can't save in the middle of one. You get 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, so save to a fresh slot before every chapter finale, and at the start and end of each chapter.

Rockstar took police off the GTA 6 minimap, so in a chase you're flying blind, unless you click both sticks (L3 + R3) for Focus. It reveals nearby officers, even through walls. Break line of sight first (a wall, a tunnel or a corner), then use Focus to spot the gap and slip away.
